ad.headline: Free: The First Thru-Hike Guide
ad.text: Everything we wish we knew before our first long trail. Instant download.

phase: Reading the ad's promises (Muse Spark Open, open weights)

assertions.claim: The First Thru-Hike Guide is available as a free instant download

phase: Following the funnel like a customer (Muse Wonder · computer use)

modelText: Testing the free instant-download promise — entering email to see if the guide arrives right away.
Guide appeared instantly after submitting — checking that the PDF download works.

Checked promise a1: Landing page offered "The First Thru-Hike Guide" as "Free PDF, instant download" via email form. Submitted test@offertest.ai (no payment/card) and reached "Your guide is ready" page for "The First Thru-Hike Guide – PDF from Alder Trail Co." with a "Download the guide (PDF)" button. Clicking that download button led to "404 – This page could not be found," so the actual PDF download failed despite the free/instant promise.

summary: Agent checkout skipped: no catalog item matches the ad's landing page /store/guides/first-thru-hike

phase: Judging each promise against word-for-word evidence (Muse Wonder + quote check)

verdicts.pageQuote: This page could not be found.
verdicts.reason: The 'Download the guide (PDF)' link leads to a 404 page, so the promised free instant download is not delivered.

fix.summary: Fix the broken 'Download the guide (PDF)' link on /store/guides/first-thru-hike so it delivers the free PDF instead of a 404.
fix.rationale: The ad is right about the free instant download, but the page's 'Download the guide (PDF)' link returns a 404, so the link is what's broken.
steps: In the website admin, open Pages > First Thru-Hike Guide (/store/guides/first-thru-hike) for editing.
Select the 'Download the guide (PDF)' link and change its URL to the live guide PDF in Media/Files, uploading the PDF there first if it is missing.
Check by opening the live page and clicking 'Download the guide (PDF)' to confirm the free PDF downloads instantly with no 404.
